operator_io_quirks: Table/column names are mixed-case (Community_Area, FBI_Code, Population, report_no); must double-quote and match case-insensitively.
Crime has 268002 rows > max_rows_per_table 300000? no, under cap, but largest table; read once per worker, rowid%k sampling.
Crime.date is TEXT storing '1/1/2018 2:46' (M/D/YYYY H:MM, no leading zeros) — declared TEXT so TS dispatches String, not Date.
Crime.latitude/longitude are TEXT holding decimal strings ('41.94456125','-87.72668181') — String fuzzer, not Number.
Community_Area.population is TEXT with comma-grouped numbers ('54,991') — String fuzzer; numeric comparisons would need CAST.
Crime.arrest/domestic are TEXT 'TRUE'/'FALSE' (not bool/bit) — String fuzzer, not Bool.
Crime.iucr_no TEXT values ('110','143B','1310') differ in shape from IUCR.iucr_no ('031A','031B') — FK child/parent value sets not identical; some Crime.iucr_no may not match IUCR (dangling FK).
Crime.fbi_code_no samples include '15','14','18' (no letter) vs FBI_Code '01A','01B' — FK parent may be missing for some child values.
Crime.ward_no storage includes null though null_rate 0.0 reported; FK to Ward(ward_no) — nullable FK child.
Ward.alderman_name_suffix null_rate 0.9, distinct 1 ('Jr.') — near-constant column; String fuzzer will mostly generate junk.
District.email/twitter samples start with U+00A0 non-breaking space; Ward addresses contain U+00A0 — String fuzzer charset lacks it.
Neighborhood PK is neighborhood_name (TEXT), FK community_area_no -> Community_Area; Crime has no FK to Neighborhood (no neighborhood_name column).
operator_ts_expectations: All TEXT columns (date, latitude, longitude, arrest, domestic, population, zip_code-as-text) get String fuzzer: random a-zA-Z0-9() strings + contaminate — implausible for dates/coords/booleans -> likely FN on date-range, lat/lon-range, arrest='TRUE' predicates.

Number fuzzer on INTEGER PKs (community_area_no, district_no, ward_no, report_no) draws uniform in [-10^scale,10^scale] then +-1/+-2 perturbation — values far outside 1..77/1..50/1..22/1..268002 -> FN on range/equality predicates.

FK child columns (Crime.ward_no etc.) draw from parent's FINAL filtered values with replacement — ties/duplicates preserved, good for joins; but parent PK filtering may shrink parent below child cardinality.
String fuzzer on iucr_no/fbi_code_no generates random strings not matching parent code shapes -> join predicates on these FKs may return empty -> FN.
String fuzzer on arrest/domestic generates random strings, never 'TRUE'/'FALSE' -> predicates arrest='TRUE' return empty -> FN.
String fuzzer on date generates random strings, never 'M/D/YYYY H:MM' -> date LIKE/range predicates return empty -> FN.
Number fuzzer on zip_code (INTEGER) draws huge ints, not 606xx -> zip predicates FN.
String fuzzer on latitude/longitude (TEXT) generates random strings, not decimal coords -> coordinate predicates FN.
PK uniqueness enforced by sample_fresh_primary_keys; unique columns dropped — but no unique columns besides PKs here, so few FP from missing ties.
Small tables (Community_Area 77, District 22, Ward 50, FBI_Code 26) get sizes from choose_table_sizes (30..2500) — may exceed original cardinality, creating duplicate-ish rows but PK filter caps.
String fuzzer on side (9 distinct) / index_code (2 distinct) / crime_against (4 distinct) generates random strings, losing the small enum -> FN on side='North' etc.
Number fuzzer on city_hall_office_room (4 distinct: 200,305,300,302) draws wide ints -> FN on room predicates.
